copy.tagline: 管理应用状态并编写测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用Flutter开发应用并需要状态管理
copy.tagline_en: Manage app state and write tests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Flutter and need state management

howto.what: 当你需要管理 Flutter 应用状态时，Claude 会根据 bloc 库的最佳实践，指导你创建 Cubit 或 Bloc、设计状态类、连接 UI 控件、编写单元测试，并给出代码示例。
howto.when: 当你在创建 Cubit/Bloc、建模状态（sealed class 或 enum）、连接 BlocBuilder 等控件、编写 bloc 测试或决定使用 Cubit 还是 Bloc 时，Claude 会提供专业建议。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 LoginCubit，包含加载、成功、失败状态。
say.note: Claude 会生成 Cubit 和状态类代码。

say.text: 用 sealed class 为订单模块建模状态。
say.note: Claude 会给出 sealed 子类的定义和示例。

say.text: 写一个 LoginBloc 的测试，使用 blocTest。
say.note: Claude 会提供 mock 仓库和测试用例。

howto.what_en: When you need to manage Flutter app state, Claude guides you in creating Cubits/Blocs, modeling state with sealed classes or enums, wiring UI widgets, writing tests, and following bloc best practices with code examples.
howto.when_en: When creating a Cubit/Bloc, modeling state (sealed class or enum), wiring BlocBuilder etc., writing bloc tests, or deciding between Cubit and Bloc, Claude provides expert advice.

say_en.text: Help me create a LoginCubit with loading, success, and failure states.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the Cubit and state class code.

say_en.text: Model the order module state with sealed classes.
say_en.note: Claude provides sealed subclass definitions and examples.

say_en.text: Write a test for LoginBloc using blocTest.
say_en.note: Claude offers mock repository and test cases.
